The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9cf38a67706f91fa), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. statement: Let ω be a free ultrafilter on N, and let τn ∈ T(Q) be arbitrary. For a bounded positive sequence (xn), the formula ρ([(xn)]) = sup ε>0 lim n→ω τn((xn − ε)+) (3.1) defines a lower-semicontinuous tracial weight on D. Its rank functional is dρ([(xn)]) = sup ε>0 lim n→ω dτn ((xn − ε)+). (3.2) If σ = limn→ω τn in the canonical topology on T(Q), then ρ|Q = σ.
